instruction: Install the Hello Extensions extension manually from the helloExtension folder on the Desktop.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: Task requires loading the extension and verifies by checking if 'Hello Extensions' (the extension name from manifest.json) appears in the list of installed extensions. Uses existing getter function get_find_installed_extension_name.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts installed extension names from Chrome Preferences file by reading extensions.settings[id].manifest.name
Metric correctly checks if expected extension name exists in the list of installed extensions using is_in_list
Complete coverage: instruction requires installing extension, evaluator verifies extension appears in installed extensions list
Data flow is correct: getter returns list of extension names, metric checks if 'Hello Extensions' is in that list
Expected value 'Hello Extensions' correctly matches the actual extension name from manifest.json
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' (uses rules['expected'] to access value)
